claim: § The Technical Side: 'Our ears interpret small dynamic range as proximity' — compression alone moves the singer from 'over there' to 'right here', until over-compression sounds fake.

pieces.what: One dry vocal through uncompressed / 4:1 / 20:1 with matched loudness; listener answers 'where is the singer?' — and a fourth version with proximity bass and no compression, testing whether dynamic range alone carries closeness
pieces.walks_up_from: a whisper and a shout in the same phrase

pieces.what: Threshold/ratio/attack/release on the same vocal with a gain-reduction meter, so each parameter's mapping is heard before it is read
Parallel compression blend knob, dry to crushed
